newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - USAir resumed as strong buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - USAir resumed as strong buy.

text.p: - Salomon Brothers airline analyst Julius Maldutis reestablished coverage of USAir Group with a strong buy rating.
- Salomon expects the airline to reach a comprehensive pact with its unions for "significant cost reductions and productivity improvements."
- USAir is expected to announce a major aircraft acquisition plan for up to 120 aircraft, which would yield "major cost savings."
- Salomon set a target trading price of $28 to $32 a share over the next six months for USAir's stock. USAir traded at 17-3/8, unchanged, in Friday afternoon trading.

- USAir recently announced plans to terminate its marketing and code sharing pact with British Airways Plc. The move is part of USAir's strategy to become an independent airline with a strong transatlantic presence, Salomon said. By being independent, "USAir increases its changes of initiating a bidding contest among U.S. airlines," Salomon said.
- Salomon sees USAir's capacity and traffic each growing about two percent in fiscal 1997, while unit costs will rise by about 2.1 percent.
